verdict.rationale: Porting a number out is a fair question for a business phone service like RingCentral, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers port-out, lock-in or early-termination fees, or in-app access to the account details (account number, port PIN) that a gaining carrier needs. The only relevant material is pricing, trial and API documentation unrelated to porting, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a founder, I can port my number out without lock-in fees, with the account details the gaining carrier needs available in the app
